decisions.reason: The LED component selection is owned by the decorative-lighting Requirement. The candidate already separately records the same message's social-media visual goal, and its visual-identity state requires no LED-selection attribute.
Choosing compatible LED components does not change the machine's beige-and-green color scheme or finish.

Approval of suitable LEDs does not change the established DJ-style control appearance or bowl measurement markings. The unresolved on-off-switch suggestion does not establish a new control-styling value.
The LED selection does not alter the placard text, position, orientation, display sides, or wording.
The source decision concerns LED selection and does not change the cursive E markings, their coverage, or their color.
Authorization for the freelancer to choose compatible LEDs does not necessarily modify the BOM deliverable, sourcing strategy, or existing BOM approval status.
Decorative LEDs are unrelated to the materials used for food-contact components.
The source does not establish any change to enclosure size, thickness, or accepted form; compatibility with the setup does not entail altered enclosure dimensions.
This candidate's acceptance condition concerns compatibility among motor shafts, couplings, controllers, and the power setup. Selecting suitable LEDs does not change that existing condition.
The LED decision does not alter the whisk dimensions, design, material, or fine-powder mixing criteria.
Choosing compatible LEDs does not change the machine's structural support or operational-stability requirements.
Lighting around the bowls does not necessarily change bowl removal, swapping, or clearance behavior.
